input.jobDescription:
Full Stack Engineer at RepeatCo

RepeatCo is looking for a skilled Full Stack Engineer.

In this role, Python will be your primary backend language. Our APIs are written in Python. Our data pipelines run on Python. Our ML scripts use Python. You should be very comfortable with Python.

On the frontend, we use JavaScript exclusively. All client code is JavaScript. Our React components are JavaScript. Our build tools are JavaScript-based. If you love JavaScript, you'll feel right at home.

We also use Python for automation scripts, Python for testing with pytest, and Python for our CLI tools.

The full list of what we use:
- Python (backend, data pipelines, automation, CLI, tests)
- JavaScript (frontend, React, build tooling)
- Python with FastAPI for REST endpoints
- PostgreSQL for primary data storage
- Redis for caching
- Docker for containerization
- JavaScript with React for UI
- Python type hints and mypy
- JavaScript with Node.js for tooling

Apply at repeatco.com/jobs
